irst Club Assembly – Rotary Year 2026–27
The Rotary Club of Bombay Central held its first Club Assembly of the Rotary year 2026–27 at the IMC, in the presence of Assistant Governor Rtn. Jayesh Ruparel.
The Assembly proved to be a fruitful and engaging session, with an overview of the various projects and activities successfully undertaken during the first two months of the Rotary year. The initiatives were well received and appreciated by the members.
The meeting also provided an opportunity for meaningful interaction, with members contributing constructive suggestions and valuable inputs, all of which were duly noted.
The Assembly concluded on a warm note of fellowship, with members enjoying a sumptuous high-tea spread and lively camaraderie.
